teacher.preprocess: native uint8/255; grayscale repeat three channels; Torch bicubic resize antialias=True align_corners=False to252; clamp[0,1]; ImageNet mean[.485,.456,.406]/std[.229,.224,.225]; no crop
teacher.mapping: token center native=(u+0.5)*256/18-0.5; bilinear token-feature interpolation to structural center 8*k+3.5 with align_corners=False,border; renormalize interpolated descriptors before prototype softmax

prototypes.policy: all eligible train families equal weight; one native256 optical pair and64 normalized patch tokens per family; no validation or RGB512 in fitting

training.augmentation: unchanged native256 OSFamilyDataset sample/epoch-seeded SAR affine; optical identity; training epochs1.. as needed
training.architecture: frozen normalized128d SAR descriptors -> Conv1x1(128,128) -> GELU -> Conv1x1(128,32) -> softmax

routing.lambda_calibration: final trained head, fixed training monitor only; min(1.0,0.10*within_query_structural_score_rms_std/within_query_semantic_bias_rms_std); zero if bias std<1e-8; freeze before any validation routing
routing.zero_lambda: exact original spatial_candidates call, all4 outputs bit-identical
routing.candidate_order: two original structural peaks first, two fused peaks next; same24px NMS over union; @1 remains structural top1
routing.shuffle: per-sample deterministic permutation of all32x32 SAR semantic positions including invalid locations; structural scores and support unchanged

bootstrap.unit: family; descriptive interval only, not repeat-seed evidence

fixed_checkpoint_policy: epoch30 is diagnostic endpoint, not selected as superior to25; never unfreeze structure or select a checkpoint by validation
evaluation: existing952-pair training monitor and952-pair fixed validation; identical plans/masks/144queries/24pxNMS/4candidates/8px recall
sealed_pools: OS final test1696 and UBCv2 test1625 remain sealed, no new model inference
interpretation: latent prototype semantics, no land-cover class names; synthetic-label-relative source-family validation, not geographic independence or fine-precision certification
